feedback: Decision: approve. This candidate is the best raced design (iteration 6, score 372.74: kd 0.40, kp 3.0, ki 0.30, base_speed 1.5, sensor x = ±0.032 m, footprint 0.016 m, last_direction) with one change, base_speed 1.5 to 1.3. Iteration 6 showed kd 0.40 raised oval finishes from 7 to 19 of 20 and cut oval line-loss events from 1.2 to 0.25, so the damping step worked. Its oval steering_oscillation of 0.285 is above the 0.25 warning level, but that is a jitter signal, not a completion failure, and finishes rose. My earlier conditional was only partly met: oscillation did not fall below 0.25, though finishes did not drop either. The speed test is still a clean single-variable step from the best design, and the s-bend (progress 0.32) and slalom (progress 0.16) failures are the main remaining losses. I make no claim about how it will perform. Read the race as follows. If s-bend or slalom progress rises and oval finishes stay at 19 or more, keep base_speed 1.3, then test kd 0.35 alone to reduce the oval oscillation of 0.285. If s-bend and slalom progress fall, or oval finishes drop below 15, return to base_speed 1.5 and test kd 0.50 with kp 3.0, since the damping direction has been the productive one so far. Keep kp at 3.0; kp 3.5 lowered the score in iteration 2.
requested_changes: If s-bend or slalom progress rises above the iteration 6 values (0.32 and 0.16) and oval finishes stay at 19 or more, keep base_speed 1.3 and test kd 0.35 alone, since oval steering_oscillation was 0.285 at kd 0.40 (iteration 6), above the 0.25 warning level.

If s-bend or slalom progress falls, or oval finishes drop below 15 of 20, return base_speed to 1.5 and test kd 0.50 with kp 3.0, ki 0.30 and x = ±0.032 m, since kd 0.30 to 0.40 raised finishes from 7 to 19 (iteration 5 to 6).

Keep kp at 3.0 and ki at 0.30 in this step: kp 3.5 at the narrower spread (iteration 2, score 99.25) and ki 0.60 (iteration 4, score 103.99) both lowered the score, so they are not the lever to change here.
